props.name: tone
props.description: Solid semantic or product colour (overrides the variant colour).

props.name: size
props.description: The control ladder. Primary actions on mobile use 'lg' (48).

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows a spinner, blocks presses and announces `loadingLabel`.

props.name: label
props.description: Required: the accessible name (what it does, not "button").

props.name: selected
props.description: Toggle state for icon toggles (favourite, mute).

props.name: direction
props.description: 'stack' puts actions full-width in a column (bottom of forms).

props.name: onPress
props.description: Makes the whole card one pressable target (navigates to detail).

props.name: accessibilityLabel
props.description: Accessible name when pressable.

props.name: leading
props.description: Icon, Avatar or flag before the text.

props.name: value
props.description: Trailing text (variant 'value' or 'navigation'), e.g. "English" or an amount.

props.name: trailing
props.description: Custom trailing content (overrides the variant's).

props.name: checked
props.description: For switch / checkbox / radio rows.

props.name: destructive
props.description: Button rows: red, for destructive actions (Sign out, Delete).

props.name: header
props.description: Section title above the group.

props.name: footer
props.description: Helper text below the group.

props.name: inset
props.description: Divider inset: 16 for text rows, 56 when rows have a leading icon.

props.name: animate
props.description:
Animate value changes: the new figure rises in on the spatial spring.
Wraps the text in a view, so leave it off when Amount sits inside other text.

props.name: currency
props.description: ISO 4217 code, e.g. 'USD', 'EUR', 'INR'.

props.name: locale
props.description: BCP 47 locale.

props.name: size
props.description: `display`: a hero figure in the brand face with a quieter symbol and minor units.

props.name: tone
props.description: `auto` colours gains success and losses error (use with signDisplay).

props.name: signDisplay
props.description: e.g. 'exceptZero' to show "+" on gains.

props.name: dot
props.description: A status dot before the label (replaces web StatusPill).

props.name: src
props.description: Image URL. Falls back to initials when missing or broken.

props.name: name
props.description: Person or org name: initials and the accessible name.

props.name: badge
props.description: Online/status dot.

props.name: max
props.description: Avatars shown before "+N".

props.name: inset
props.description: Indent from the start edge (aligns with list text after a leading icon).

props.name: action
props.description: One action, e.g. <Button variant="text">Review</Button>.

props.name: bottomOffset
props.description: Extra space above the bottom inset, e.g. the tab bar height.

props.name: children
props.description: Extra content between the description and the actions.

props.name: actions
props.description: 1–2 Buttons; put the confirming action last.

props.name: dismissable
props.description: Tapping the scrim or Android back closes it.

props.name: size
props.description: Circular diameter.

props.name: action
props.description: Primary next step, e.g. <Button>Add money</Button>.

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Shows a Retry button (messages.retry).

props.name: label
props.description: Visible label above the field (also its accessible name).

props.name: helperText
props.description: Hint under the field. Replaced by `error` when set.

props.name: error
props.description: Error message: red outline, announced, replaces the helper text.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Parsed value (rounded to the currency's minor units), or null when empty.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the value, e.g. "Guests".

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the group.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name (visible label lives in the ListItem / row next to it).

props.name: formatValue
props.description: Announced value text, e.g. (v) => `${v}%`.

props.name: selected
props.description: Toggle state (filter chips).

props.name: onRemove
props.description: Shows a remove button (its label is messages.remove).

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the whole row, e.g. "Amazon, minus $42.50, today".

props.name: onPress
props.description: Tap / double-tap action of the row (open details).

props.name: actions
props.description: Revealed by swiping toward the start edge. Each one is also an accessibility action.

props.name: width
props.description: Page width.

props.name: children
props.description: Scrollable content above the footer.

props.name: footer
props.description: The flow's primary action(s), kept above the keyboard and the home indicator.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name, e.g. "Verification code".

props.name: onComplete
props.description: Called once all digits are entered.

props.name: secure
props.description: Dots instead of digits (PIN). Turns off one-time-code autofill.

props.name: onKey
props.description: Called with '0'–'9', the decimal key or 'delete'.

props.name: decimal
props.description: Show the decimal key (money).

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name, e.g. "Amount to send".

props.name: caption
props.description: Shown under the amount, e.g. "Balance $1,240.00" or an error.

props.name: label
props.description: What it is, e.g. "Balance" (used for the toggle and the masked reading).

props.name: children
props.description: The formatted value, e.g. "$12,480.50".

props.name: cover
props.description: Shown over the app in the app switcher (e.g. your logo).

props.name: preventCapture
props.description: Block screenshots and recording (Android FLAG_SECURE; iOS hides the content in captures). Needs expo-screen-capture.

props.name: arrow
props.description: Which side the arrow is on (towards the thing it explains).

props.name: dismissLabel
props.description: Dismiss label.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name; also shown when `extended`.

props.name: platforms
props.description: Platforms that render it (a FAB reads as Material; iOS uses a toolbar or nav-bar button).

props.name: bottomOffset
props.description: Extra bottom offset, e.g. the tab bar.

props.name: detents
props.description: Heights the sheet rests at: 'content' (fits its content) or a 0–1 fraction of the screen.

props.name: dismissable
props.description: Drag down, tap the scrim or Android back closes it.

props.name: scroll
props.description: Let the content scroll (long lists).

props.name: onPress
props.description: Tap action of the wrapped content (long-press opens the menu).

props.name: body
props.description: Why the app needs it, in the user's terms.

props.name: onAllow
props.description: Calls the OS prompt.

props.name: header
props.description: Optional profile row/card above the groups.

props.name: thinking
props.description: Assistant is thinking (before the first token).

props.name: terms
props.description: Legal copy (auto-renewal terms).

props.name: logo
props.description: Brand mark above the title.

props.name: footer
props.description: Primary action(s), kept above the keyboard.

props.name: error
props.description: Error from the last attempt (announced).

props.name: biometricLabel
props.description: Offer passkey/biometric sign-in (name the method: "Sign in with Face ID").

props.name: title
props.description: Copy overrides.

props.name: destination
props.description: Where the code went, e.g. "+65 •••• 4821".

props.name: resendAfter
props.description: Seconds before Resend is allowed again.

props.name: unlockLabel
props.description: "Unlock with Face ID" / "Unlock with fingerprint" (name the method).

props.name: onUsePasscode
props.description: Fallback to the app passcode or password.

props.name: greeting
props.description: e.g. "Good morning, Mei". Leave out when the native header shows the title.

props.name: balance
props.type: { value: number; currency: string; label?: string }

props.name: quickActions
props.description: Send, Add money, Request… Up to four fit one row.

props.name: recent

props.name: onSeeAllActivity
props.description: Shows "See all" beside Recent activity.

props.name: labels

props.name: step

props.name: quote

props.name: confirmLabel
props.description: "Confirm and send".

props.name: confirmHint
props.description: Biometric confirmation, named: "Confirm with Face ID". Shown as the hint under the button.

props.name: actions
props.description: Swipe actions per row (also accessibility actions).

props.name: rows

props.name: amount
props.description: Hero figure (e.g. the amount sent).

props.name: icon
props.description: An icon from `@nexub/icons/native`, e.g. `Search`.

props.name: color
props.description: Colour role.

props.name: padding
props.description: Padding on every side (spacing token).

props.name: paddingX
props.description: Horizontal padding (start + end, so RTL is free).

props.name: gap
props.description: Gap between children.

props.name: haptic
props.description: Haptic played on press (Apple: not for plain taps — toggles, selections, outcomes).

props.name: stateLayer
props.description: On-colour of the state layer, or false for none.

props.name: pressScale
props.description: Press-scale target, or false for none.

props.name: scroll
props.description: Scrolls (and lets a native large title collapse).

props.name: edges
props.description: Safe-area edges to pad. A native header already covers 'top'.

props.name: padding
props.description: Content padding.

props.name: gap
props.description: Gap between children.

props.name: tone
props.description: Tonal tier.

props.name: material
props.description: 'glass' is for the control layer only (bars, floating controls), never content.

props.name: radius
props.description: Corner radius: a shape token or dp.

props.name: variant
props.description: Type role.

props.name: color
props.description: Colour role.

props.name: tabular
props.description: Tabular figures, for numbers that line up.

props.name: family
props.description: Overrides the role's family (e.g. 'mono' for codes).
